items.title: Take a short walk after meals
items.text: Your sugar rose about 18.7 mg/dL less after meals when you walked. Aim for 10 to 20 minutes after dinner, where the program saw the biggest gain (18.3 mg/dL). A check in real adults (CGMacros) pointed the same way, at about a fifth of the program's size, but it is not proven there yet.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: You didn't have any dinners that started at 8 pm or later, which is good because sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners. Keep having dinner before 8 pm to avoid a rise in your sugar.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: You averaged 13.1 hours of overnight fasting, which is great since 100.0% of nights reached 13 hours. Having an overnight fast, like you did, is part of your routine and was also studied in the program.
